source_export_diagnostic.interpretation: The same final learned LoRA is evaluated with pre-finetuning BN buffers to reproduce the original repository save behavior. This diagnostic makes no optimizer updates, changes no other base parameters or evaluation settings, and does not replace the main trained-model result. The official checkpoint has unknown training membership and is context only.

official_main.interpretation: internal adapter classifier logits, not generated LLM label accuracy; paired observations repeat queries; fallback policy, if selected, is a separate auxiliary experiment

model_definitions.pre_lora_adapter: base adapter from the SAME exported checkpoint with LoRA deltas disabled; includes that checkpoint's saved BatchNorm buffers, and is NOT necessarily the original pre-finetuning checkpoint
model_definitions.final_lora_adapter: same exported base adapter and BatchNorm buffers with its saved LoRA deltas enabled

official_corpus.interpretation: training-corpus replay: all released corpus entries are used for training by upstream, and all 600 query IDs map to the reconstructed vibration training split; not held-out validation

reference_label_audit.method: apply the same fixed label parser to official reference responses; no examples are removed from reported scores
reference_label_audit.caveat: references can themselves omit a diagnosis; high text overlap does not establish correctness

metric_definitions.generation: greedy natural generation; max_new_tokens as configured; official repetition penalty retained
metric_definitions.parsed_prediction: task0 leading yes/no; other tasks earliest explicit canonical class mention, absent=-1(error)
metric_definitions.unigram_f1: multiset word overlap F1 after the same normalization
metric_definitions.rouge_l_f1: exact word-level LCS F1 after the same normalization, without stemming
metric_definitions.reference_token_nll: teacher-forced reference response including terminal EOS; prompts excluded; not generated-token accuracy
metric_definitions.limitations: lexical overlap is not a maintenance/risk factuality or safety assessment; no human or LLM judge; no paper BERTScore claim
